product.name: Room of Days tap refinement audition
product.promise: Accepted ordinary actions feel crisp, close, and pleasantly substantial while retaining the approved Room gesture vocabulary and its silence.
owner_quotes: the tap sounds just don't sound good
the sound changes notes as you keep clicking around
a tap sound should only be triggered when you directly tap a quest but don't trigger its completion, not when you just swipe around not intending to tap anything

shared_dna.transient: Retain each approved source's first-contact edge and onset; refinement begins only after the protected contact window.
shared_dna.body: Move a small, time-bounded amount of existing energy into the compact source body; WEIGHTIER doubles that same modest body boost.
shared_dna.harmonic_field: No added notes, retuning, phrase, melody, or variation: existing source tuning and global walk remain unchanged.
shared_dna.texture: Reduce high grain after contact while retaining the original material texture; page preserves its fiber movement and glass keeps its initial distinction.
shared_dna.space: No added space, room tone, noise, reverberation, or Foley. Existing source boundary remains intact; glass ring is only subtly shortened after its contact.
shared_dna.dynamics: Each rendered master is normalized to its source 260–8000 Hz energy within 0.01 dB. Existing global walk and rapid-tap gain policy are unchanged.

mix.rapid_policy: Unchanged runtime global walk and gain logic: ordinary has five source variants, every material role has three, and fast taps retain existing attenuation/no-immediate-repeat behavior.
mix.ducking_policy: Unchanged runtime hierarchy. The audition preserves its existing music ducking and gives the locked completion outcome its existing space; no candidate becomes louder through mix priority.
silence_policy: bare scrolling without a pressed control
canceled drag never commits or plays outcome
mix.compound_outcome_rule: Recorded flow: one contact then locked outcome75ms later. Live sandbox: visible press has one contact; only accepted click schedules outcome, at least75ms after contact. Cancellation produces no outcome.
mix.voice_stealing_rule: Unchanged runtime director rule: a higher-priority outcome steals the oldest lower-priority contact first; equal priorities use existing deterministic scheduling.
mix.state_dedupe_rule: Unchanged runtime state-transition guard: only accepted, meaningful actions voice. Repeated selected-state actions and cancelled gestures remain silent independently of rapid-tap attenuation.
mix.settings_rule: Unchanged runtime mute, haptic, reduced-feedback, and external-audio behavior. This audition changes no routing or user setting.

auditions.question: Does REFINED keep the approved gestures recognizable while making ordinary tapping feel crisp and more pleasantly substantial without becoming louder, poppier, or a new melody?

provenance.policy: Audition-only derivatives of exact approved Room masters. No production asset, routing, global walk, gain logic, source pitch, duration, or rare outcome is changed. Candidate processing adds no notes, noise, reverb, Foley, compression, or new randomization.

records.scope: 47 masters: four ordinary roles with five takes each (20), nine material lanes with three takes each (27); three families yield141 entries.
records.families: CURRENT byte-identical; REFINED complementary time-varying EQ/body redistribution; WEIGHTIER doubles REFINED's modest lane body boost.
